Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Interactive Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Interactive Listening, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to understand the speaker’s intended meaning? 2. How can one seek clarification on what the speaker means?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration as the learner listen actively and keenly as they watch a video in which people clarify

and verify a speaker’s meaning.

verbal and non-verbal cues for negotiating meaning.
